## About
AM Automotive is a full-service repair shop on Old Bayshore Highway in San Jose. We work on all makes and models, and we aim to be your best alternative to a dealership.
Manjit Singh, our head mechanic, keeps things simple. After we diagnose your car, we walk you through what we recommend and how much labor it will take. We won't push a service your car doesn't need.
Neighbors have given us a 5-star rating across 64 Google reviews. Stop by or give us a call when your car needs attention.

## Services
- Maintenance service: Inspection of major systems, spark plugs and wires, filters, fluid checks and top-offs, tire rotation, differential check, timing belt inspection and brake servicing.
- Brakes: Brake pad replacement, rotors, shoes and drums, brake fluid flush and ABS light diagnostics. One reviewer brought in a Camry for a brake job and wasn't disappointed.
- Heating and air conditioning: AC recharge, compressors, condensers, radiators, heater cores, fans, hoses and thermostats. One reviewer said Manjit fixed their AC for a very reasonable price.
- Engine and drivetrain repairs: Tune-ups, oil changes, timing belts, water pumps, check engine lights, transmission, clutch replacement, and CV boots and axles.
- Suspension and steering: Shocks and struts, control arms and bushings, rack and pinion, wheel bearings, differential, power steering and tie rod ends.
- Electrical diagnostics: Battery service, alternators, starters, power windows, door locks and other electrical problems.
- Failed smog diagnostics: If your car fails smog, we track down the cause, including oxygen sensors, catalytic converters and factory exhaust.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: All makes and models, whether your car is Japanese, American or European.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: You can request a free quote through our website, or give the shop a call with your question.

Q: My car failed smog. Can you help?
A: Yes. We diagnose failed smog checks and work on oxygen sensors, catalytic converters and exhaust.
